## Purpose
The chat input: an auto-growing textarea with send and stop, and a slot above the box (for example the files about to be sent).

## Responsibilities
- `Composer({value, onChange, onSend, onStop, busy, above, …})`. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a new line.
